title: Approve Packet Cover Split (type/strata cover)
question: Revised: no auth-cover-field or hero imagery. Cover is typography, rules, Signal Ticks, and strata only. Pick Desktop A or B as the north star; confirm mobile.

options.label: Desktop A — Canonical type cover
options.thesis: ~40/60 Cover Split: date masthead → title → lede → session/focus strata → TOC. Substantial through type and rules — no plate.
options.viewport: Form left with Signal Ticks + TradePilot and teal Sign in. Cover right builds the packet face from Castoro date, briefing title, SESSION/FOCUS meta, and hairline TOC.
options.risk: Without a plate, empty cover risk — A counters with session meta + TOC strata density.

options.label: Desktop B — TOC-forward strata
options.thesis: Same 40/60 split; quieter masthead/title; deep TOC block is the cover’s dominant move, with a compact text register footer.
options.viewport: Form rail unchanged. Cover leads with contents-scale Watchlist / Alerts / Market context rows and a tabular open/close register — still no imagery.
options.risk: TOC scale can make the cover feel like a feature list if strata rhythm is weak.

options.label: Mobile — Compact masthead + form
options.thesis: Date + Signal Ticks + title under a rule, then form. No plate, no TOC, no stacked desktop cover.
options.viewport: Compact masthead then logo + Welcome back + credentials + teal Sign in.
